Majeed Syndrome The presentation of persistent fever, aseptic pustulosis, erythema nodosum, omphalitis, neutrophilic infiltration, and elevated IL-1β/IL-6 in an infant is classic for DIRA, a life-threatening autoinflammatory disease caused by IL1RN mutations. DITRA and PASH syndrome are also autoinflammatory conditions with overlapping pustular and neutrophilic features, but DIRA best explains the early-onset omphalitis and failure to thrive.
